verdict.rationale: Mollie documents fast integration paths for taking card payments online. Installing the module from a platform store is described as 'enough to start receiving payments', and there are hosted checkout pages, no-code payment links, and Mollie Components card fields. Nothing in the evidence addresses how long it takes from sign-up to live acceptance, so the 'within a day' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented sign-up-to-live timeline, account verification/activation speed, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-payment.
